meta.title: AI employees for real work
meta.description: Hire an AI employee with a role, a voice and your company's context. It answers clients, researches and drafts on a schedule, and nothing goes out without your approval.

hero.headline: AI employees that do real work
hero.subhead: A marketer, a researcher, developer support, an assistant, a support desk. Each one works from your documents, on a schedule, and asks before anything goes out.
hero.note: Free to start. Five minutes to a working agent.

features.heading: Not a chatbot. A staff.
features.intro: Every agent has a job, your context, and tools that reach the outside world - behind your approval.

items.title: A marketer that drafts on a schedule
items.body: Every Monday at nine, Nova reads what your competitors announced, drafts the post in your voice and queues it for your approval.

items.title: A researcher that cites its sources
items.body: Sol answers a standing question every week with a brief you can check: numbered sources, quotes, links. Emailed to you.

items.title: Developer support that reproduces the bug
items.body: Ada reads your API docs, explains the fix with a code sample, reproduces the problem, and logs the issue for engineering with steps.

items.title: An assistant that keeps follow-ups moving
items.body: Kai drafts the email with the numbers from your notes, schedules the next step himself, and never commits you to anything without asking.

items.title: Support that answers from your own documents
items.body: Mia searches the policies and product sheets you upload and answers from them, naming the source. When she doesn't know, she says so.

items.title: You approve anything that leaves the building
items.body: Posts and emails wait in one inbox with the full text. Approve, edit or reject - from your phone. Every decision lands in the audit trail.

roles.heading: Eight roles, ready to hire
roles.intro: Each one is a job, a voice and a rule for when to fetch a human. Pick one and change anything.

pricing.heading: Pricing that follows the work
pricing.intro: Pay for agents that are live and the work they do. Start free. Upgrade when one is earning its keep.
pricing.footnote: Every plan includes every role, unlimited teammates, the audit log and email support.

items.q: What can an agent actually do?
items.a: Answer clients on a chat link or a widget on your site, log bugs and requests, research the web with sources, draft posts and emails, schedule its own follow-ups, and escalate to a person when its rule says so.

items.q: Will it send something I haven't seen?
items.a: No. Every agent starts in draft-only mode: publishing a post or sending an email waits for your approval in the Inbox. You can loosen that per agent, per tool, once it has earned it.

items.q: Where do its answers come from?
items.a: From the documents you upload and from cited web research. When it doesn't know, it says so rather than guessing.
Yes to start: one live agent with enough runs and conversations to see it work. Paid plans add agents, runs and a larger model budget.
About five minutes. Pick a role, name it, upload a document, test it live, publish.

items.q: Does my data train anyone's model?
items.a: No. Integration credentials are encrypted at rest, and nothing you upload is used for training.
